summary: Buscar Medicamento feature in Janela ANVISA tab tested successfully. Backend endpoint GET /api/anvisa/buscar-medicamento works correctly - searches multiple official sources (DOU, CMED, ANVISA news, AnvisaLegis) and returns structured results with risk levels. Frontend UI elements verified: search input (data-testid='anvisa-busca-input'), search button (data-testid='anvisa-busca-btn'), Enter key trigger, loading spinner, results panel with red header, fonte badges, result cards with Ver Documento and Esclarecimento buttons, X button to close. All 9 backend tests passed, all frontend tests passed.
